name: The Art of the Imbue
summary: Galvan the Ancient asks you to bring him mithril and citrines in Stranglethorn. He needs them for an imbue.

sections.title: Materials for Galvan
sections.body: The materials Galvan the Ancient requests are specific: forty Mithril Bars and four Citrines. You are to bring them to him in Stranglethorn for the imbue he seeks.

faq.answer: Galvan the Ancient asks you to bring him forty Mithril Bars and four Citrines.

faq.q: Where do I bring the materials?
faq.answer: Bring the Mithril Bars and Citrines to Galvan the Ancient in Stranglethorn.
Galvan the Ancient needs the materials for an imbue.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Art of the Imbue
